STANDARD LUXURY FEATURES: Rapid Spec 100A
ENGINE SEATING
5.4L SOHC 3-valve V8 FFV 1st-row premium leather-trimmed, heated and cooled, low-back bucket seats with
310 hp @ 5,100 rpm/365 lb.-ft. of torque @ 3,600 rpm 10-way power adjustments, including power lumbar and recline, 2-way adjustable
28-gallon fuel tank head restraints with embroidered Lincoln Star, and driver’s side memory
2nd-row premium leather-trimmed, heated, low-back fold-down bucket seats with
DRIVETRAIN recline and easy entry to 3rd row
6-speed automatic transmission with tow/haul mode 3rd-row PowerFold® 60/40 split bench seat
Rear-wheel drive (RWD)
INTERIOR
WHEELS | TIRES 110V AC outlet
18-in. 7-spoke aluminum wheels with 17-in. steel spare 1st-row center floor console with floor shifter, armrest, covered storage bin with
chrome handle and two-tiered storage, 2 front cupholders, auxiliary audio input jack
BRAKES
and USB port, rear audio/climate controls, 2 headphone jacks and 2 rear cupholders
Power 4-wheel disc brakes with Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS)
2nd-row center floor console with padded armrest, covered storage and
SUSPENSION | STEERING 2 cupholders
Front and rear stabilizer bars Authentic walnut swirl wood, Alloy Metallic and Burnished Bronze interior accents
Independent front and rear suspension Auxiliary climate control with 2 overhead vents for 2nd and 3rd rows, plus controls
Variable-assist power steering in overhead console and back of 1st-row center floor console
Dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control
EXTERIOR
Chrome-accented lower bodyside cladding AUDIO | COMMUNICATION SYSTEMS
Chrome exhaust tip Lincoln SYNC voice-activated, in-vehicle connectivity system
Class III/IV Standard-Duty Trailer Tow Package with frame-mounted trailer hitch SIRIUS Satellite Radio with a 6-month introductory subscription
receiver integrated into rear fascia, 4-pin wiring harness and trailer sway control THX® II Certified 5.1 Surround Audio System with AM/FM stereo/single-CD/
Fog lamps DVD/Jukebox, HD RadioTM technology, MP3 capability, 14 speakers (including an
Forward Sensing System 8-in. rear subwoofer), 600 watts of power and 12-channel amplifier
Luggage rack with chrome accents and Black crossbars Voice-activated Navigation System featuring SIRIUS Traffic and SIRIUS Travel Link
(with 6-month introductory subscription), nearly 10 gigabytes of digital storage for
Power-deployable running boards
pictures and music and on-screen image from rear view camera
Power-folding, heated sideview mirrors with chrome caps, security approach
lamps, integrated turn signals, memory and driver’s side auto-dimming feature
SAFETY | SECURITY
Power liftgate
3-point safety belt restraints for all seating positions; height-adjustable in 1st row
Power rear quarter windows
AdvanceTrac® with RSC® (Roll Stability ControlTM)
Privacy glass
Driver and front-passenger airbags,1 safety belt pretensioners, safety belt energy-
Projector-style high-intensity discharge (HID) headlamps with autolamp feature
management retractors, safety belt usage sensors, driver’s seat position sensor,
Rain-sensing windshield wipers: speed-sensitive intermittent (front); crash severity sensor and restraint control module
2-speed wiper with washer (rear)
Front-seat side airbags1
Rear view camera
Lower anchors and tether anchors for child-safety seats (LATCH) in all 2nd-row seating
Reverse Sensing System positions; tether anchor only in 3rd-row center
Tow hooks integrated into front fascia MyKey® owner controls feature
INSTRUMENTATION | DRIVER CONTROLS Perimeter anti-theft alarm
Accessory delay for power features with theater-dimming lighting Remote Keyless Entry System with integrated keyhead transmitter remotes (2),
Illuminated Entry System, and security approach lamps in sideview mirrors
Auto-dimming rearview mirror
Safety Canopy® System with 3-row side-curtain airbags1 and rollover sensor
Leather- and wood-trimmed steering wheel with controls for audio,
Lincoln SYNC,® cruise control and Navigation System SecuriCodeTM keyless entry keypad
Memory settings for driver’s seat position, sideview mirrors, power-adjustable SecuriLock® Passive Anti-Theft System
pedals and power-tilt steering column SOS Post-Crash Alert SystemTM
Message center with compass display, distance-to-empty, average fuel economy,
odometer and trip odometer
Overhead console with 1st-row map lights, sunglasses storage, power rear quarter
window switches, conversation mirror and universal garage door opener
Power-adjustable brake and accelerator pedals with memory
Power-tilt steering column with memory
Power windows with front one-touch-up/-down feature
White LED-backlit instrument cluster with speedometer, tachometer, battery
gauge, fuel level gauge, coolant temperature gauge and message center
